desc:
Imagine if Aya's reaction speed is so extreme that she can counteract Sakuya's time manipulation. Like for one, the time-stopping is not automatic. Sakuya has to consciously activate the effect. That split-second moment there might just be all the fastest in Gensōkyō needs.

And this is referencing [**this Dragon Ball panel here.**](https://assets.st-note.com/img/1740161828-CcENLR7QvrU4K2Iqiwfa395Y.png?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)
